intro: Play the story first, then clean up. The order below is built from the official trophy descriptions alone: story chapters and missions first, stranger strands as they appear, then activities, collectibles and money. Early guides put the platinum at roughly 200 hours; there are no online trophies and no difficulty trophies, so it is long, not hard.
saveWarning: No mission replay is reported (Output Lag), so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission. Keep cheats off your trophy save — they are reported to disable trophies and saving.

stages.text: Follow the main missions in order. This stage earns the chapter trophies (Paradise Lost, T**s Ass Drug Money, Vice City, Baby!, Top Of The World, Ma), the opening mission (Just Like Paradise) and the named story missions (Trust, Break the Bank, Family Matters, DWNFALL, Hi-Jacked, Snow Storm). Both protagonists are playable from Chapter 2, which opens most free-roam trophies.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 4

stages.text: Take every stranger mission you find and follow each chain to its final mission — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have a finale trophy, and any 8 finished strands earn Strangers & Freaks. Three more strands beyond the five named ones are out in the state. Do these during the story, not after it.
stages.title: Stranger strands as they appear

stages.text: Complete the final mission for You Gotta Know When to Get Off (gold). Finishing the story opens the 100% completion checklist (Touch Pad, Progress, 100% Completion) — the tool for the whole cleanup phase. Save before the final mission.
stages.title: Finish the story, then the final mission

stages.text: Work the repeatable list: 250 stunts (397 exist), gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, a Top Fun drone win at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, all 9 activity types once, 50 challenges, the fishing challenge against Cal, one arcade game, the unique-animal hunt for Bret, 5 enemies in one Combat Focus, the Rhino tank, and an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Check the Progress screen for counts as you go.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.text: Meditate at all 18 spots (do the Chapter 1 spot before that chapter ends — see Missables), complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, discover 100 vehicles, and explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Collect as you travel; the map and the Progress screen show what is left.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.text: Rob 5 bank vaults, one armored truck and one illegal operation per gang (9 gangs), one jewelry store undetected, and the partner robberies (see Missables). Then the money trophies: launder $250,000 of Marked Bills, spend $100,000 across shops, buy all 8 garages and register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Robbery trophies open up in Chapters 3 and 4.
stages.title: Robberies, money and property

stages.text: Work the 100% checklist to the end for A Long Road (gold) — 15 of the 18 card sets count toward it. Mop up the vague trophies last: the partner moment (Personal Best), the story choices (Actions Speak Louder), the second try (Bad Luck, I Guess), the strange encounter (The Truth Is Out There), the melee drive-by (Ten Pin) and the Ocean Beach cocktail (In The Beginning…). When all 54 are earned, Vice Got a Price! unlocks.
stages.title: Cleanup: 100% and the platinum
